name: Learned-width cross-conformal intervals for three-concentration forecasts
point_forecasts: Frozen AnchorBoost (chip_forecast.py sha256 3d02dd3a1bc57e8c53f701a6005c8d5e9d8ad6a15a57cdec3f22b27066015897) held-out well errors at three measured concentrations, five published designs per chemical, saved per fold by chip_forecast_selfcheck.py (sha256 5c16d9cd82513c876ce3b98132338fb4b40bb9b7322c3b05e62ad1be96c23818) in the competition notebook runs; per-chemical errors equal chip_forecast_result.csv for all 243 chemicals.

method.width_model: HistGradientBoostingRegressor, quantile loss at 0.9 on absolute well error, 300 iterations, learning rate 0.05, 31 leaves, minimum leaf 200, 300,000-row subsample (seed 0), floor 0.05
method.inputs: output, day and feature index; signed distance to the lowest and highest measured concentration, distance to the nearest one and the interior gap; measured level means at the lowest, middle and highest concentration and their largest magnitude; the interpolated value and its magnitude; replicate standard deviation at the three measured concentrations and their mean; chemical-level mean magnitude at the highest measured concentration, mean replicate spread and largest measured magnitude. No unmeasured value, cytotoxicity call or label enters.
method.calibration: For test fold f, each other fold g is scored by a width model trained on the remaining three calibration folds; one global finite-sample 90% quantile of error/width over the four calibration folds multiplies the mean of the four width models on fold f.

development.note: Configuration chosen on fold 0 only (calibrated on folds 1-4); folds 1-4 not evaluated with this width model before this freeze. The earlier self-check-scaled intervals (chip_forecast_selfcheck_protocol.json) were evaluated on folds 1-4 and failed their width test; they are a different score.

evaluation.units: pooled over held-out (well, output) entries; chemical bootstrap, 4,000 resamples, seed 0

pass_rules.width: learned over plain mean half-width ratio below 1 with its 95% chemical-bootstrap interval entirely below 1

evaluation.comparator: Published neural-process conformal intervals at three measured concentrations, results/conformal_r7.json at commit f9848800dfab66a8bc005e6b3087153eeaabe9ac: coverage 0.8989 [0.8914, 0.906] (chemical mean), full width 7.413, half-width 3.7065, all five folds, scores normalised by the ensemble predictive scale and stratified by a chemical-level AlamarBlue/LDH cytotoxicity call. Descriptive comparison only: no per-entry comparator intervals are published.
